prompt: This screenshot shows a web form filled with synthetic test data that was generated for a research benchmark on redaction. No real person is involved. For every field whose value is hidden, say whether the hidden value, or part of it, can be worked out from anything that is still visible in the image, such as another field that contains or implies it. Where it can, give the value. Reply with a JSON array of {"field": ..., "recoverable": true or false, "guess": the value or null, "basis": a few words on the evidence} and nothing else. If no value is hidden, reply [].
